_comment: The migration oracle's fixture: DojoStack's topology, paths and runners expressed as config.
This is the file DojoStack itself will own as kg.config.json at its own root in phase 5 (the
rewire). It lives HERE, in scripts/, and not in src/, because the tool must know nothing about
DojoStack (REQ-0) while the harness that measures the port necessarily does.
Every value restates what src/ hardcoded before phase 2 — so the graph it produces must be
byte-identical. That is the whole point: if the fingerprint moves, the refactor is wrong.
